alerte.texte: Merged: the colors (one green for the Yes, "Rising" stays red), the rounded comment field, error reports from the phone on the test server, and the conversation opening, switched on for the test server. The last four iPhone changes are in review.

depuis.texte: A test made reliable (nothing changes in the app)
Colors: the only green left is the Yes; the reds are the No and the actions that delete. "Rising" and the trend dot stay red, like news.
Android: lighter, faster release builds (nothing changes on iPhone)
Avatar editor: an option tile keeps its previous image until the new one is drawn, instead of an empty bust.
Error reports from the phone: script errors only, on the test server only
Comments: the comment field is a rounded pill, like in Messages
Android: predictive back on Android 13 to 15, without losing Back (nothing changes on iPhone)
Server: the newest message in the inbox is switched on for the test server
Messages: a long conversation opens at your tap on its newest message, then the history fills in above without moving anything. Short conversations are unchanged. Switched on for the test server.

Messages, server part: the inbox can carry each conversation's newest message, for the apps that ask for it, and opening any conversation now costs the server three times less planning. Nothing changes until the app part is merged.
A test that failed at random now waits for its votes to settle. Nothing changes in the app.
Avatars: the headphone band now follows curly hair instead of floating above it. Shaved heads are unchanged.
Android: native page swipes get their own server switch, on wherever the iPhone's is. Nothing changes for today's phones.
Android: two tests made independent of their environment. Nothing changes in the app.
Website: a search that finds accounts but no take shows the accounts alone, like the app.
Avatars: after a failed 3D load, reopening the avatar shows the loader until its first image, instead of an empty view.
Explore on Android: the theme list no longer fades during a swipe, and search results swipe between tabs like on iPhone. A bug found on the bench was fixed first, then measured again: no slowdown.
A test that failed at random on everyone's checks now waits for the screen to settle. Nothing changes in the app.
Search: when a search finds accounts but no take, the accounts show alone, without the "No take for ..." line, as you asked.
Avatars: if the 3D avatar fails to load, the next tap tries again instead of staying stuck.
Messages: the first part of opening any conversation at your tap, the format the inbox will use. It changes nothing on its own.
A library update for the server and the app, done now as you asked, after checking the package.
Avatars, full-body view: the bottom bar steps aside while it is open, so the feet show. It leaves and comes back in one frame, as you chose.
Very large text: a button label now shows at its final size from the first frame. Captured at the largest text size: same look, no shrink.
Server tooling only: the staging configuration check now counts what a deployment really sends, so it cannot pass while the real upload would fail.
Bottom bar: a long press on another tab opens it, like on iOS. Checked on the bench: the long press, the swipe across the bar and the plain tap all behave as before or better.
Server: stricter limits on one request, ahead of a library update.
Avatars: the full-body view is switched on on staging, as you decided.
Avatars: glasses now follow a customized nose. You approved the boards.
Test tooling: two automatic phone tests no longer miss the link-copied and GIF-saved confirmations.
Friends: coming back to Friends from Nearby or the map no longer reloads the list. One light request instead of two or three, and less jank; measured on the bench.
Avatars (behind the switch): the full-body view keeps the enlarged size you approved while it turns.
Admin only: the arrow keys move through the moderation queue.
Profile song (switched off): the preview no longer downloads before you tap play.
Feed videos: two downloads of the same video piece can no longer overwrite each other. The video preparation itself stays switched off in this build.
Avatars, docs only: the before and after boards of the corrected avatar benchmark.
Avatars: the ring and little fingers are no longer stuck together at rest.
Avatars (behind the switch, off): turning the full-body avatar resumes without a jump after a two-finger gesture.
GIFs everywhere (comments, the GIF picker, Takes and the player) are now prepared on disk only, so none can freeze the screen the first time it shows.
Reduce Motion: the GIF of a Take no longer plays when the phone asks for fewer animations.
Build tooling: the iOS test build pipeline is more reliable (nothing changes in the app)
Avatars (behind the switch, off): the full-body view keeps the same zoom while it turns.
Messages: a conversation with a GIF opens right away. The first tap used to freeze the screen for 11 to 13 seconds; it now opens in about a third of a second.
Avatars: the reference thumbnails are redrawn after the rendering fix.
Avatars: the hand keeps its shading during the wave (no visible change).
Tooling only: a type-checking test now first proves that the checker reports a known error.
Avatar tests only: the avatar benchmark imports its reference wave again.
Tooling: a native patch that last night's Expo update had stopped applying is back, and a check now refuses any patch that no longer applies.
Stickers: a sticker draft you cancel no longer comes back the next time you open the picker.
Docs only: the web and Android parity inventory of 08/10, which three other docs already pointed to.
Audio import: the player and the copies of an imported audio file are released after use, so a second import works.
Tooling: the ten Expo patches published on 12/10 are installed now, by your decision, so every check is green again. Native, in the new binary.
Staging tool only: the route sweep now tells « more calls » from « same calls, each slower », so a slower route is diagnosed at once.
Tests only: an API test dated on a fixed day no longer turns red a week later.
Test builds only: the double-tap fix now installs once even when two JavaScript engines start together. The final loop found it; nothing changes on testers' iPhones.
Full-body avatar: the body now fills the viewer (88 to 92% of its height on render boards); it stays switched off until you say yes.
Web: a page reloaded within 30 s of your vote also reads your vote from the main database, like the app does (nothing changes on the iPhone).
Web: the browser also says it just voted for 30 s (nothing changes on the iPhone; it prepares switching the protection on in production).
Launch: while the black launch screen is up, the app underneath is hidden from VoiceOver and test robots, so nothing reaches it through the screen.
Friends: after a server error during a deploy, the app goes back to its light request 10 minutes later instead of waiting for a relaunch.
Home top tabs: two quick taps on Nearby then Friends now end on Friends.
Double taps: every tap of a fast burst now reaches the app, not only the first (vote 4/10 to 10/10, repost 4/6 to 6/6 on the tickets' exact pairs), with no fluidity loss on five gestures.

Your vote re-read from the main database no longer costs a cache check on every read: for 30 s after you vote, the app says so in a header (measured on staging: ordinary reads no longer pay the extra check; the re-read stays switched off in production).
Fewer requests: Friends checks for new Takes with a light request instead of re-reading its whole first page (full reads halved, same fluidity).
Avatar: the headphone band now rests on curly, short curly and short waved hair instead of cutting through it.
Avatar: when its 3D view is hidden, disabled or closed, the iOS rotations still waiting are cancelled, so nothing turns on its own when it comes back.
Avatar: the avatar is prepared once a scroll settles, not during it; measured on the bench with no fluidity loss (slow frames 14 and 14, total jank 2720 to 2632 ms).
Explore: a tap on a far theme slides the page you leave fully drawn, with no blank page; counted frame by frame in Release.
Fewer requests: reopening a conversation no longer re-reads it while the live connection kept it up to date (5 minutes at most).
Fewer requests: presence beats once per 5-minute slot instead of every 2 minutes.
Server, staging only: right after you vote, your votes are read from the main database, so a lagging copy cannot show an old vote. Being measured on staging.
Fewer requests: the app sends its analytics every 55 s instead of 15 s, without losing events.
Fewer requests: waiting for a duel no longer re-reads the game every 8 s while its live subscription runs.
Fewer requests: a repost, a delete or a new post re-reads only your own profile, not every profile.
Fewer requests: when iOS goes briefly inactive (control center, a notification banner), the app no longer re-reads what is on screen.
Map: a WebKit proof vehicle for the ambient map (source only).
Explore: a page you leave stays drawn instead of flashing white or black (6 to 1 flashes in light, 4 to 0 in dark), measured in Release.
Avatar: the palm's shading follows its rotation near the wrist.
Avatar: the elbow's compression is bounded exactly during the wave.
Avatar: the fingers' shading follows their curve.
Avatar: the skin no longer shows through the sleeve at the elbow during the wave.
Avatar: the shoulder and sleeves keep their volume during the wave.
Profile: a vertical swipe that starts on the Takes, Questions and Game tabs now scrolls the page (stuck 2 times out of 2 on main, scrolls 3 out of 3).
Explore: only the page on screen re-reads its N°1 (38 to 10 reads on the measured path, 64 to 36 requests), with no fluidity loss.
Open Take: its counters re-read every 30 s when calm instead of 12 s (6 to 4 reads a minute), measured with no fluidity loss.
Test loop: flow 23 now swipes from the card's question, not from its vote count hidden under the floating tab bar.
Welcome screen without an account: one big « Create an account » button, and « Log in » as a small line. You approved it.
Test loop: Take relaunches without camera, photos or microphone access, like a new tester.
Avatar: the thumb's shading follows its rotation during the wave.
Comment and Take translations: a pending translation is re-read 4 times at most, more and more spaced out, instead of up to 20 times.
Test loop: it opens a thread from a notification and comes back to the list.
Your conversation that froze 2 s on a cold start: the thread now gets ready while the app is idle, before your first tap. Measured on a Replicas iPhone with no slowdown.
Web, switched off: a bounded proof of the web telemetry transport on staging.
Proof only: pictures of the bottom bar hidden on an open Take and in Activity, light and dark.
Test loop: it answers the iOS camera alert like a new tester would; proven on a fresh simulator, fresh and already allowed.
Map, switched off: the nearby places read less data before showing their cards.
Avatar, switched off for now: see the avatar full body like Instagram, and turn it with a swipe. You approved it; it gets bigger before it is turned on.
Avatar: the hand keeps natural poses during the whole wave.
Map, switched off: the nearby places on the map get their own cache.
Server: on the map, one place search counts once in the budget, not once per letter, with keys hashed with a secret.
Avatar: if the end of a wave gets lost, taps work again instead of staying blocked.
Mentions: after the first letter the list follows in about 11 ms; from Korea the first list comes in 386 ms instead of 527.
Development only: a red error banner on a fresh install no longer covers the tab bar. Nothing changes in TestFlight.
In a list, a media of an unknown newer kind drops only that media: the Take stays and can still be voted.
Server: the map's place and activity reads no longer check the « just voted » mark, and a test now makes every new route say whether it serves votes.
Map, built in but switched off: nearby places like schools on the map, plus a general address repair.
Largest text size: the « Choose a place manually » button keeps whole words.
Test loop: the profile steps scroll from the list, not from the tabs row.
Server and web: the unknown-media report is sent at most once per kind and per hour.
Avatars: a real human wave, from public motion capture, is measured as the reference for a more natural wave.
Tools only: a dependency lock repair for crash reporting.
Avatars: one tap plays one single wave, never several.
Test only: the rollback script of the latest database change is now tested.
Mentions follow every letter, with no extra read when a shorter search already had the full answer.
Composer: scrolling a panel no longer redraws the whole composer.
Public pages without an account keep their pictures when one media kind is unknown, and the problem is reported.
Hick's law point 5: after « @ », mentions offer the people of the thread first, then your inbox. An anonymous author never moves up.
Videos ahead in the feed: built in but switched off. On, a video starts 29 times faster with half the data, but scrolling costs a little more work.
Server: for 30 s after you vote, your own reads come from the main database. Switched off until it is measured on staging.
Fewer requests: back on your Profile, the friend count and score are re-read after 2 minutes instead of 30 s, and right away after a friend change.
Fewer requests: Expert notes are re-read every minute only on a Take that has some, or for an Expert. Pulling to refresh re-reads them.
Tool only: a bench that fires taps less than a millisecond apart on a cloud iPhone.
Composer: « No limit » instead of « More options », and an open panel scrolls fully above Publish, as you chose.
Map search: suggestions follow every letter, and the panel stays still while you type, as you chose. On Android, the back key shrinks it back.
Your TestFlight bug: a vote you just made no longer disappears for a moment, in the feed or in the opened Take.
In a list, one card of an unknown kind is skipped and reported, instead of blanking the whole list.
Old builds no longer break when the server adds a field to an answer: new builds ignore fields they do not know, and the tests stay strict.
Server, outside the app: an alert is claimed before it is sent, so it is never sent twice.
Server, outside the app: trace reports keep only their redacted copy, never the original.
Hick's law point 10: the composer has a single sound button. Tap the mic to record, long-press it to import a sound.
CI: the secret scan can no longer be skipped by its cache, and every step has a time limit.
App: when a screen's answer breaks its contract, the app reports which screen and field (never any data), instead of a silent « Couldn't load ».
Hick's law point 8: the map keeps a single arrow, « Around you » gets a list icon, and « Search here » appears when you move the map.
Website: notifications are marked read only up to what you actually saw; « Read all » had no limit at all.
Test only: website tests wait for React to finish before removing their page, which ends random « window is not defined » failures.
Server: traces of a withdrawn vote are forgotten after a minute, as the code says, instead of about an hour.
Test only: two flaky security tests run on a frozen clock, and a rule nobody tested is now tested.
Test only: the avatar editor's flaky tests drive their own clock.
Test only: a flaky KnowMe test on the website now holds its own timers instead of the real clock.
Test loop: on a Mac without cloud storage, the Takes tab no longer shows « Couldn't load »; an image the contract refuses is just left out.
Team only: first step of a performance patrol, a measurement chain marked advisory.
Team only: an observability console, with its screens and a browser SDK for the website and the console.
Private profile: a locked profile now shows Friends, Takes and Score. Your TestFlight point.
Hick's law point 12: in search, « Sort by » stays only on the Top tab; Latest, Photos and Videos keep Date and From.
Hick's law point 3: the sign-in sheet has no cross any more, only « Later » and a swipe down.
CI: the picture check of pull requests no longer takes a bot's logo for a screenshot; only real pictures count.
CI: the app's page names are finally type-checked, so a link to a page that does not exist can no longer pass.
Server: checks of curated videos no longer call the video sites in bursts after a delay; they stay 50 ms apart.
Test loop: the development seed now writes everything the regression loop needs, so no more manual catch-up after each seed.
CI only: the nightly route sweep may now write its tracking tickets.
Messages: a thread opened from a notification now goes back to your inbox with Back, like X and Instagram.
Messages: tapping the Messages tab from inside a thread always lands on your inbox, clearing the threads opened on top.
Website: documents always show in the chosen language, and the welcome page is no longer fetched ahead of time.
A lint rule now blocks the two ways of opening a page that skipped the double-tap guard. Found by the Hick's law audit.
Every pull request that changes the app must now show it breaks nothing (its regression study), or a check fails. Your request of 10/10.
Profile song chip and picker on mobile and web

On the map search, picking a suggestion writes its name in the bar, ready to be written over; the places follow the typing sooner and the flight takes 1.2 s instead of 2.4. Your TestFlight point; for the next build.

Messages and the Profile are prepared ahead while you rest on Amis, switched off by default. Measured on a cloud iPhone: off, it costs nothing; on, it slows nothing and makes launch lighter (12 network reads instead of 22). For the next build.
An official Take's video is removed only when the video site says it is gone twice, a day apart; one passing error no longer removes it for good. It reaches staging with the next server deploy.

equipe: Here on the Mac: me and six Claude agents (the last iPhone pull requests for build 197; the go page and test notes; the regression re-reads; the search for leftover fades; the bench tools; the test fixes), six Codex agents on the avatars, four Codex agents on Android and five Codex agents with a Claude lead on the desktop website.
Replicas: stopped and our machines deleted, by your order; nothing is done there, its branches are only picked up and finished here.
etapes: Finish the review of the last four iPhone changes, film the profile song search and the feeds without fade on the bench, and finish the burst test.
Finish the seventh regression re-read, then run the fluidity gate and the full test loop on the final commit.
Then the go page and your go for the iPhone build 197.
